title: Dashboard Settings → Notifications: enable push on the installed app
goal: The installed dashboard app (the one paired by QR, F-118) asks for notification permission on a tap in Settings and registers its push subscription with the service, as the workspace toggle does (owner report 2026-11-24: no permission prompt on the iPhone)
acceptance: Settings → Notifications shows the state: On, Off, Blocked (with where to allow it), not supported, or that a Safari tab needs the Home Screen app

Enable notifications asks for permission on the tap, subscribes with the service's VAPID key through the dashboard's own service worker (sw.js, scope /dashboard/) and stores the subscription with POST /api/push/subscribe; Turn off removes it there and unsubscribes
A paired device credential (F-118) is accepted by the push endpoints as a dashboard session is
The service offers no test-notification endpoint, so there is no Send a test notification button; a reminder due in a minute is the test (docs/acceptance/f004-t06-phone-push-procedure.md)

A browser test on the production build across the join: dashboard at /dashboard/ with a device credential, Settings button, permission (stubbed), subscribe (stubbed push service), the server stores the subscription
Gauntlet: nerv-system-flows/browser and multi-step-agent/* went pending on this source; an owner-approved gauntlet run covers them before this step is verified
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no real push service, subscription or device data in Git or tests.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed (1.5 h agent). Not a measurement.
